entries.text: That’s the first signboard...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_010_brother_01

entries.text: S-sorry, did I startle ya?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_010_brother_02

entries.text: I-I did mention that I’d hang back an’ follow you\nhere...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_010_brother_03

entries.text: We’re s’posed to read the signboard, right?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_010_brother_04

entries.text: Oh, I already know the whole story, so...g-go\nahead. You should check it out.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_010_brother_05

entries.text: Long, long ago, there was a fearsome ogre in the\nland of Kitakami.
entries.label: sdc01_side01_010_system_01

entries.text: The ogre made its home in the mountain behind\nthe village, frightening all who ventured there.
entries.label: sdc01_side01_010_system_02

entries.text: One day, the ogre came down from the mountain\nin a terrible rage, causing great fear in the village.
entries.label: sdc01_side01_010_system_03

entries.text: By some stroke of luck, Okidogi, Munkidori, and\nFezandipiti all happened to be there as well.
entries.label: sdc01_side01_010_system_04

entries.text: The three Pokémon laid down their lives to fend\noff the ogre and send it back to the mountain.
entries.label: sdc01_side01_010_system_05

entries.text: In admiration, the people of the village bestowed\nupon this brave trio the title “the Loyal Three.”
entries.label: sdc01_side01_010_system_06

entries.text: Their remains were given a proper burial, and\nstatues of the three were erected above the site.
entries.label: sdc01_side01_010_system_07

entries.text: The Loyal Three Monument is right over there...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_010_brother_27

entries.text: But don’t you think the ogre in that folktale\nsounds kinda...cool?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_010_brother_06

entries.text: Yeah, it sure does!
entries.label: sdc01_side01_010_select_01

entries.text: You think...?
entries.label: sdc01_side01_010_select_02

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Right?! I knew you’d get it,
[VAR 0x0100(0000)]!\c
It was up against three whole opponents at once,
battling it out all by itself—wowzers, that’s so cool![VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_010_brother_07

entries.text: C’mon, it was all alone!\c\nThe battle was three against one, but the ogre\nstill managed to hold its own. That’s way cool![VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_010_brother_08

entries.text: Oh... But I guess most people would just think\nan ogre like that is scary, huh? I don’t think\r\nthere’s any reason to be afraid...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_010_brother_09

entries.text: When I was little, I went up into the mountain so\nmany times at night—all on my own—an’ I never\r\nonce met that ogre.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_010_brother_10

entries.text: Only scary thing that happened was the\ngrown-ups givin’ me a real earful about it...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_010_brother_11

entries.text: Umm... So yeah, we’re s’posed to take a photo\nin front of the signboard, right?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_010_brother_12

entries.text: I don’t have a smartphone... Could you...?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_010_brother_13

entries.text: That turned out great. You’re even good at\ntaking photos...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_010_brother_14

entries.text: Thanks!
entries.label: sdc01_side01_010_select_03

entries.text: You wanna try?
entries.label: sdc01_side01_010_select_04

entries.text: S-sorry... Not trying to butter you up or anythin’...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_010_brother_15

entries.text: Oh! No! I didn’t mean—\c\nM-maybe...next time...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_010_brother_16

entries.text: Y’know...I didn’t wanna have to come do this\nwhole school trip thing, but...well...it might\r\nactually be kinda fun...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_010_brother_17

entries.text: I get to be out in nature around my hometown...\nand talk to you, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_010_brother_18

entries.text: H-hey, if you want, maybe we could set up a\npicnic. Would you like a sandwich—?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_010_brother_19

entries.text: Agia!
entries.label: sdc01_side01_010_legend_01

entries.text: Gyah! Wh-what is that thing?! Some kinda...kaiju\nor somethin’?![VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_010_brother_20

entries.text: A “kaiju”? This is Koraidon!
entries.label: sdc01_side01_010_select_05a

entries.text: A “kaiju”? This is Miraidon!
entries.label: sdc01_side01_010_select_05b

entries.text: This is my ride. It’s called [VAR 0x1107(00FF,0202)]KoMiraidon!
entries.label: sdc01_side01_010_select_06

entries.text: It’s called Koraidon? And you ride on it, huh...?\nI’ve never seen another Pokémon like this...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_010_brother_21

entries.text: It’s called Miraidon? And you ride on it, huh...?\nI’ve never seen another Pokémon like this...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_010_brother_22

entries.text: And it seriously comes out whenever it hears\nthe word “sandwich”?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_010_brother_23

entries.text: Agias.
entries.label: sdc01_side01_010_legend_03

entries.text: Never thought I’d actually get to meet such an\nawesome Pokémon.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_010_brother_24

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]No wonder you’re so strong,
[VAR 0x0100(0000)]...
You’re...you’re
special.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_010_brother_25

entries.text:
So, the next—! Errr, we should go find the next
signboard! It’s on the grounds of Kitakami Hall.\c
Um, Kitakami Hall is...\c
Well, first double back to town from here, then
there’s this bridge you cross, and from there,
you’ll need to climb up the mountainside.\c
I’ll hang back for now an’ meet you there later![VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_010_brother_26

entries.text: Agia...?
entries.label: sdc01_side01_010_legend_02
